title: Thunderskin Cloak
summary: Damaging the wearer while Reverberating can leave an attacker Dazed.

fields.Dazing Echo: A Reverberating creature that damages you makes a DC 13 Constitution save or becomes Dazed for 2 turns. Opportunity Attack damage qualifies.
fields.Dazed: Disadvantage on Wisdom saves, loss of Dexterity AC bonus and inability to spend a Reaction. Help removes it.
fields.Acquisition: Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or Crimson Draughts.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
